matching_config.note: date_tolerance_days and settlement_match_tolerance_pct were selected via a 5-seed sensitivity sweep, not single-dataset tuning - see README for the comparison table. llm_confidence_threshold was not swept due to API cost/time; documented as a known remaining gap.

note: In production, fee_config would be fetched per-merchant from Razorpay's account API rather than stored in a static file - merchants negotiate individual rates.
